text: ABSTRACT & RATIONALE
textPreview: ABSTRACT & RATIONALE

name: motivation_body
text:
Cell-free ISAC needs both globally cooperative communication and a sparse, physically meaningful sensing cluster. We minimize transmit power subject to robust communication SINR, sensing SINR, and PCRB tracking constraints.

The key modelling decision is asymmetric gating: b_mp authorizes only the target-p dedicated sensing waveform S_p; communication covariances remain globally cooperative.

name: system_body
text:
• M=6 APs, N_t=2 antennas/AP, K=3 UEs, P=2 targets
• Each target receives exactly N_req AP authorizations
• Total AP transmit power is hard limited by P_max
• Selected APs carry nonzero dedicated sensing power
• FIM geometry drives sensing-cluster choice; robust beams absorb communication QoS pressure

name: result_summary_title
text: RESULTS AT A GLANCE
textPreview: RESULTS AT A GLANCE

name: summary_body
text:
• Dual DC: median binary distance 5.94×10⁻⁵ over 25 scenarios
• Robust design: 0 sampled outage under tested CSI errors
• Nominal CSI: 89–92% mean outage under the same perturbations
• M=12 sweep: lowest conditional mean power 35.72 mW at N_req=4

All reported performance is post-recovery and physically validated.
